title: command -- the CommandEnvelope and the cmd_receipt body
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/command.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = oneOf the CommandEnvelope (sec 1.1 -- the body of a Medium type=command posted to _ops; wire.md owns the outer envelope and cites this file for the body, schema-by-reference) and the cmd_receipt body (sec 3 -- conductor-only, phases ack/progress/result over cmd_id; everything receipted including refusals). Emit/read: emitters mint STRICTLY (registry verbs, schema-valid fields -- hence additionalProperties false); readers are liberal on fields (unknown fields round-trip unmodified) and CLOSED on verbs (unknown verb => refused(invalid)). Sec 1.3 defaults are FROZEN for MAJOR 5. R3 fallbacks: unknown verb -> refuse-typed; unknown field -> preserve; unknown refused_class/outcome/state value from a NEWER minor -> render verbatim, treat as non-terminal unless phase says result. $defs also carry the narration struct (sec 3.2) and the routine spec (sec 6.1). The command.kind registry (sec 2 -- THE one home; wire.md 3.1 delegates here) is modeled at $defs/command_kind: envelope kinds (directive, grant, cancel), governance kinds (contract_bump, migration_epoch, stage_bump, key_rotate, adjudication, errata), fleet-decision kinds (flip, grant, revoke, park, resume -- R22, posted to _fleet), and the six operator-statute kinds (oracle.seal, oracle.errata, oracle.control, oracle.adjudicate, null.pin, crucible.resume -- s6-10, each with a Stage-1b operator-signature slot). Non-envelope kinds share the command type's ACL, never the sec 1 envelope schema.

command_kind.$comment: command.md sec 2 -- THE one command.kind registry (wire.md 3.1 delegates here; no copy exists). kind-addition = a command.md MINOR, zero wire-registry impact (ruling #692). grant/cancel appear in both the envelope and fleet-decision classes; culture disambiguates the reader (act-plane grant posts to _ops, fleet-decision grant to _fleet). Fleet-decision kinds flip|grant|revoke|park|resume are conductor-only, D-gold, R-forever (R22); the six operator-statute kinds (s6-10) each carry a Stage-1b operator-signature slot -- at/above the trigger an unsigned statute is refused(auth)

command_envelope.$comment: command.md sec 1.1 -- every MUTATING operator intent from every surface is one schema-validated CommandEnvelope through one ingress (sec 4); reads are NEVER commands (sec 7)

cmd_id.$comment: REQUIRED. Globally unique forever, SURFACE-minted; interactive surfaces SHOULD mint ULIDs; routine executors MUST mint deterministically rt:<routine_id>:<slot> (sec 6.2). Identity-dedup key (sec 4 step 3) + receipt-chain key + the Stage-1b signing nonce

issuer.$comment: REQUIRED. Authentication of the STRING is identity-firewall.md's; the unattended ceiling (sec 6.4) keys on it; issuer=conductor is legal ONLY for fabric-internal maintenance envelopes and MUST NOT carry grant/deny (sec 1.2 invariant 4)

session.$comment: REQUIRED. Surface-session id; scopes supersede (sec 5.2) and conversation state; routine sessions = routine/<id>

verb.$comment: REQUIRED. CLOSED registry (sec 2): an unknown verb is refused(invalid) naming the table; verbs compile to the seven constitutional verbs

params.$comment: REQUIRED. Per-verb typed object, strict-mint (template R5: unknown param field is an error, never an ignored extra). Per-verb field spaces are cited, not duplicated: run = a run-manifest fragment per run.md; grant/deny/cancel consumption semantics = act.md's; fire vars filtered by the routine's subst_whitelist (sec 6.1)

params_hash.$comment: REQUIRED. Over RFC-8785 (JCS) canonical form of params; the Conductor RECOMPUTES; mismatch => refused(invalid)

utterance.$comment: REQUIRED iff an NL layer produced params: the raw operator text -- provenance for the Entry-30 cross-check; absent for typed surfaces

parse.$comment: present iff an NL router produced params (audit of parsing; makes every NL-parsed scalar auditable -- F27's bar)

router_claim.$comment: the d0 router CELL that parsed it (F15: metered, ledgered)

extractor.$comment: version of the deterministic extractor that ran

extracted.$comment: scalars the extractor found in the utterance

injected.$comment: scalars the extractor FORCED over router omission

inferred.$comment: scalars the router supplied with no utterance evidence

defaults_applied.$comment: scalars filled from frozen defaults -- each narrated in ack

supersedes.$comment: OPTIONAL. A cmd_id from the SAME (issuer, session) to cancel-replace while still QUEUED (sec 5.2); superseding a RUNNING command never auto-kills

ttl_s.$comment: stale-refusal window; default 600 (stop/grant/deny: 3600); checked queue-side too (sec 4 step 8)

budget.$comment: OPTIONAL overrides; CLAMPED to fleet caps by the governor (pricebook.md); never raises a cap, only lowers

dry_run.$comment: parse + plan + intake-class + econ quote + narrate; execute NOTHING; result carries the plan + quote

reply.$comment: delivery hint; receipts land on _ops regardless -- reply shapes rendering, never truth

contracts.$comment: the surface's census expectation (kernel G3/MIG-SUR): MAJOR mismatch => refused(version) naming both versions; MINOR skew proceeds

ts_surface.$comment: informational; the AUTHORITATIVE ts is the Medium's at post; never orders anything (sec 1.2 invariant 5)

anyOf.$comment: field semantics, key custody, and verify() are identity-firewall.md's (schema-by-reference; [SECURITY-SEAM: envelope authentication])

auth.$comment: absent => an unsigned Stage-0/1a envelope (legal below the Stage-1b trigger); at/above the trigger the RATCHET law applies: issuer=operator without valid auth => refused(auth)

cmd_receipt.$comment: command.md sec 3 -- payload type cmd_receipt (wire registry row 17, conductor-only ACL, smuggled instances VOID-AT-FOLD). Chain: ack -> progress* -> result keyed by cmd_id; everything receipted including refusals; exactly ONE terminal result per cmd_id (alias chains get the result MIRRORED). The degenerate collapse (LB3): for ask (and any verb whose dispatch completes synchronously within the ack window) the chain collapses -- the terminal result doubles as the ack; no separate ack row is posted; the sec 2.1 arithmetic counts this collapsed chain (2 Medium appends). Durability: ack/result D-gold R-forever; progress D-chatter R-decay (operator-facing streaming rides it; run-internal progress stays status). The wire envelope corr carries cmd_id on every cmd_receipt; the body repeats it

ack.$comment: phase=ack (D-gold): confirmation-by-narration, emitted BEFORE dispatch (F8: misroutes surface in seconds; stop is one word)

run_id.$comment: pre-minted for run/drive: stop/watch work from second 0

provenance.$comment: per-scalar: stated | default | ... (from the parse block)

coalesced_into.$comment: alias ack: the primary cmd_id (sec 5.1); the duplicate issuer SEES the coalescing, NEVER silent

progress.$comment: phase=progress (D-chatter): state-change-driven; min-interval 2 s per cmd; event-time, never wallclock. input_required = an H2/H3 act parked or a talk clarifying question (maps 1:1 to the MCP task state); recovered emitted at restart for every non-terminal command (SUR-4b)

state.$comment: R3: an unknown state value read from a NEWER minor is rendered verbatim and treated non-terminal

result.$comment: phase=result (D-gold; terminal, EXACTLY ONCE per cmd_id). A policy refusal is a result{outcome:refused}, not an HTTP error (this body's enum is command.md's -- THE one outcome enum; wire.md 3.1 delegates here; partial is deleted, no producer)

outcome.$comment: THE one outcome enum (canon #4); no partial

refused_class.$comment: iff refused; each refusal a typed result receipt naming its override (sec 4 step 9); downgrade = the Stage-1b ratchet's stripped-signature refusal (identity-firewall.md B.6.3; SEC-3; s2-32)

cost.$comment: the canonical cost{} group (R16): members SUBSET-OF the six {usd_effective, usd_reserved, sku, purpose, resv_id, pricebook_version} -- elision is lawful, wrong members are not; wall_ms/tokens are SIBLING receipt fields, never cost{} members; member semantics owned by pricebook.md 5.2. cmd_receipt is in R2's spend crossing set -- the result's cost{} is authoritative for the whole command (W3a)

narration.$comment: command.md sec 3.2 -- the narration struct, assembled by CODE from _ops + run-culture reads ONLY; the ONLY source any surface narrates from; fields are first-class receipt/verdict/certificate fields, never prose. Rendering law: a synthesis is never rendered as verified -- the lie would have to live in a schema value (SUR-2)

vs_null.$comment: DUAL-UNIT (R15, v2 L-NULL's restored anti-flattery guard): margin_invoice is the PRIMARY operator-facing figure; a single unlabeled margin is REFUSED at schema validation

failures.$comment: tri-state failures rendered verbatim from this list

cost.$comment: sec 3.2's example prints {usd_effective}; the canonical cost{} member names (R16) are pricebook.md 5.2's

routine.$comment: command.md sec 6.1 -- routine/5.0.0: a stored CommandEnvelope + triggers; NO second scheduler exists. Slot exactly-once for free: cmd_id = rt:<routine_id>:<slot> + identity-dedup (sec 6.2). Routine specs are content-addressed at fire time (spec_sha256); an edit mid-flight never mutates a running envelope

issuer.$comment: NEVER operator -- the sec 6.4 unattended ceilings key on this string

params.$comment: ${var} substitution resolves ONLY from subst_whitelist; anything else => refused

envelope.$comment: a stored partial CommandEnvelope; indistinguishable in flow from a typed command (sec 6.3)

spec.$comment: cron: the schedule; slot = the SCHEDULED tick ISO-8601, never observed time

catchup.$comment: default skip; once fires only the single newest missed slot

unattended.$comment: H2/H3 acts PARK, never silently auto-approved; the operator key never lives on the cluster, so a routine physically cannot present the H3 signature (sec 6.4, 10-T8)
